annotations.title: RSSAmp: What the open web is writing about more than last week

description:
[RSSAmp] Subjects English blogs and news sites used in headlines more than the week before, ranked. `count` is feeds, not posts, in a one in four sample, so it measures movement rather than coverage, and `prior_count` is the same figure for the week before. Updated daily. An empty list means the rollup has not got two days to compare yet.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

window.description: Days per side of the comparison. Default 7.
